visual_qa_notes: PRE-FINAL BUILD 4 ONLY: all requested navigation/filter/guest/cancelled-preview cases passed on the recorded APK, but release text issues require a rebuilt artifact and new acceptance.
Visual QA found power_buy saying GOLD while the shop and local debit use earned coins; root corrected power_buy and moves_gold in all six languages.
Visual QA found singular equipment rewards rendered as +1 coins / +1 pièces; dedicated singular captions were added for headwear and aura in six languages.
Landscape bounds/navigation passed, but the Canvas retains a small centered portrait composition; physical legibility and touch-target acceptance are not established.
Normal app entry may record a visit and persist already-eligible local gear; this smoke never presses an explicit reward claim, purchase, equip, sign-in or ad action.
